concepts.title: Left and Right Hand Limits
concepts.formula: LHL = lim(x->a-) f(x), RHL = lim(x->a+) f(x)

questions.q: Evaluate the limit of 3x^2 + 5x + 4 as x approaches 4 (direct substitution).
By the power rule, the derivative of 5x^2 is 10x^1. Find the derivative's value at x = 4.
For y = 4x^2 + 5x + 1, find the slope of the tangent at x = 3.
For y = 4x^2 + 5x + 1 at x = 3, the tangent slope is m; find the slope of the normal (-1/m), two decimal places.
Chain rule: y = (5x + 2)^3 has dy/dx = 15(5x + 2)^2. Evaluate it at x = 3.
Second derivative test: for y = x^3 - 3x^2 + 2, y'' = 6x - 6. Evaluate y'' at the critical point x = 1 to classify it.

concepts.title: Existence of a Limit
concepts.formula: lim(x->a) f(x) = L if LHL = RHL = L
